about.heading: Who I Am
paragraphsHtml: I'm a technology enthusiast who transformed curiosity into expertise — without a traditional tech degree. My journey began with a simple question: "How does this work?" — leading me from disassembling gadgets as a hobbyist to managing mission-critical infrastructure for thousands of users.

What sets me apart is my hybrid approach: I combine enterprise-level IT administration with hands-on maker skills, cybersecurity expertise, and a passion for automation. Whether I'm managing HP ProLiant servers and Sophos firewalls at work, or building ESP8266-powered smart home systems at home, I bring the same level of precision and innovation.

categories.title: Browser-Based IT Tools & Dashboards
categories.descriptionHtml: Full-featured web apps built with Vanilla JS and Google Apps Script — enterprise-style admin consoles, network monitoring dashboards, and IT utility suites.

projects.title: ZKTeco Attendance System & ERP Console
projects.subtitleHtml: Full-stack biometric attendance solution — Python/Flask backend, real-time logger, and a unified web dashboard for HR, IT Helpdesk, and Admin operations

blocks.html: An end-to-end attendance management platform for ZKTeco biometric devices. The Python backend streams live punch events from multiple terminals into a local SQLite database, while the ERP Console — a high-performance single-page app built with vanilla web technologies — serves as the unified front end for HR, IT Helpdesk, and admin operations. Connects to a Google Apps Script cloud backend for ticketing and Drive integration. Runs on Linux, Windows, macOS, and Android (Termux).

items.title: Real-Time Logger & Sync
items.textHtml: Per-device threads with self-healing reconnect stream live punches to SQLite (WAL) and an external API with configurable batching. Bulk sync CLI supports date-range filtering; startup scripts auto-sync the last 30–60 days on boot.

items.title: HR & Attendance Management
items.textHtml: Live present/absent dashboard with per-department stats, historical reports, employee calendar, monthly summaries, shift/grace-period config, holiday management, and offline-capable remote punching via IndexedDB.

items.title: ZKTeco Fleet Control
items.textHtml: Monitor online/offline status for all biometric terminals. Remote actions from the browser: ping, sync clock, reboot. Download enrolled users, fingerprint templates, and raw logs per device.

items.title: Notifications
items.textHtml: Telegram bot alerts for device status, per-punch events, and scheduled daily absent reports. Scheduled HTML + plain-text email reports via Gmail SMTP. All settings configurable from the Admin UI without restarting.

items.title: IT Helpdesk & Collaboration
items.textHtml: Ticketing system with priority and assignment workflows, token queue for service counters, internal peer-to-peer messaging, notice board, sticky notes, WebRTC VoIP calling, and Google Drive integration via GAS.

items.title: Admin & Infrastructure
items.textHtml: Raw SQLite query console, DB backup/restore, CSV/MDB bulk import, full audit log, RBAC user management, session manager, auto-sync scheduler, integrated Linode terminal via ttyd, and 13 UI themes including glassmorphism.

projects.title: IT Tools Dashboard
projects.subtitleHtml: Swiss-army knife for IT admins — networking, security, and utility tools in one browser tab

blocks.html: A browser-based multi-tool dashboard combining commonly used IT utilities into a single interface. All processing is client-side for fast performance and better privacy. Features search filtering, favorites, keyboard shortcuts, and exportable logs.

items.title: Utility Tools
items.textHtml: QR/barcode generator, Base64 encoder/decoder, hex/binary/decimal converter, password generator with strength analysis, text diff tool.

items.title: Networking Tools
items.textHtml: IP info, DNS lookup, URL-to-IP resolution, hosting provider detection, URL shortener, subnet calculator, MAC vendor lookup.

items.title: Monitoring & Files
items.textHtml: Ping monitor with latency chart, real-time console output, Google Drive upload with QR sharing, client-side PDF editing.

items.alt: IT Tools security and converter utilities

projects.title: ZKTeco Attendance Telegram Bot
projects.subtitleHtml: Telegram-only attendance management for ZKTeco devices + Middle East Attendance Software MDB — 40+ commands, no dashboard needed

blocks.html: A fully Telegram-native attendance system that connects directly to ZKTeco biometric devices (TCP/IP via pyzk) and reads the Middle East Attendance Software .mdb database. No web server, no Flask, no SQLite — every feature is a Telegram command. Supports 40+ commands across attendance queries, device management, reporting, and admin operations.

items.title: Attendance & Reporting
items.textHtml: Today's summary, absent/present/late/early lists, who-is-in detection, weekly/monthly trends, top absentees, department breakdowns, and custom date-range history. XLSX/PNG/PDF reports via scheduled or on-demand delivery.

items.title: Per-Employee Queries
items.textHtml: Search by name or badge, today's punch timeline, month-to-date report, and a full emoji calendar grid showing daily presence/absence at a glance.

items.title: Device Fleet Control
items.textHtml: Ping all devices, sync clocks, reboot remotely, push user records across the fleet, identify orphaned device users not in the MDB, and manage device config via inline Telegram keyboards.

items.title: Notifications & Email
items.textHtml: Per-punch live alerts, device online/offline change alerts, MDB stale detection, and daily scheduled absent reports. Optional Gmail SMTP delivery with HTML/plain/both formats — all configurable from Telegram without touching config files.

items.title: MDB Backup System
items.textHtml: Inline backup panel with Telegram download, email attachment, local directory copy, and recurring scheduled delivery. All settings managed via the bot UI.

items.title: Admin & Security
items.textHtml: Password-gated whitelist-only shell session, read-only SQL console, audit log, RBAC with per-user presence tracking, and a full inline admin panel. Lockout on repeated auth failures.

projects.title: Telegram Queue Management System
projects.subtitleHtml: Full token/queue system — Telegram admin bot + FastAPI web server + real-time TV display with TTS and live tracking

blocks.html: A complete queue and token management platform built for service counters — combines a Telegram admin bot with a FastAPI web server and SQLite backend. Real-time updates are pushed via Server-Sent Events (SSE) to a TV-ready display page with browser TTS read-aloud and audio beep on every token call.

items.title: TV Display Page
items.textHtml: Full-screen NOW SERVING board with per-counter status, live waiting list, clock, and automatic TTS announcement — "Token 42, please proceed to Counter 2" — triggered instantly via SSE when any admin calls the next token.

items.title: Customer Token Flow
items.textHtml: Customers scan a QR code or visit the /take page, enter their name and department, and receive a token number plus a /track link. The tracker auto-refreshes showing live queue position without any app install.

items.title: Telegram Admin Bot
items.textHtml: Inline keyboard controls for Next / Previous / Recall / Current / Waiting per counter. Full counter management: add, rename, remove, open, close. QR code generation, queue reset with confirmation, and staff user management.

items.title: Staff Web Dashboard
items.textHtml: Browser login for counter staff — manage their assigned counters without Telegram access. Session-cookie auth with optional HTTPS-only mode. Counter assignments configurable per staff user from the admin bot.

categories.title: Ethical Hacking & Penetration Testing Tools
categories.descriptionHtml: Custom hardware tools for Wi-Fi security research and HID exploitation — built for educational understanding of network vulnerabilities.

projects.title: Wi-Fi Deauther + Wi-Fi Duck
projects.subtitleHtml: Combined hardware toolkit for Wi-Fi DoS testing and HID injection

blocks.html: A dual-purpose device combining a Wi-Fi deauthentication tool and a USB HID injection platform ("Wi-Fi Duck"), built using a Pro Micro (ATmega32U4) and D1 Mini (ESP8266). OLED display provides real-time feedback; RGB LED indicates device state. Powered by a TP4056 Li-ion charging circuit for portability.

items.title: Wi-Fi Deauther
items.textHtml: Exploits the 802.11 deauthentication frame vulnerability to disconnect devices from a target Wi-Fi network. Used for DoS demonstration and network security auditing. For educational/authorized use only.

items.title: Wi-Fi Duck (HID Injection)
items.textHtml: When plugged via USB, emulates a keyboard/mouse (HID device). Remote scripts are delivered over the ESP8266 hotspot, allowing keystroke injection undetected by most antivirus software.

items.alt: Wi-Fi Deauther and Wi-Fi Duck hardware build photo

categories.title: Home Automation & Connected Devices
categories.descriptionHtml: Full-home automation using ESP8266/ESP32, relay boards, Tasmota firmware, and voice assistant integration. Projects span smart rooms, vehicle access, and custom smart hardware.

items.title: Bedroom 1
items.textHtml: 8-channel relay + NodeMCU controlling tube lights, ceiling fan, Philips Wiz bulb, DIY RGB lamp, study lamp, and 3 sockets. Sockets auto-shutoff at 100% charge. AC via Homemate Wi-Fi IR remote with scheduled temperature automation (24°C → 26°C → off by 5 AM).

items.title: Bedroom 2
items.textHtml: Philips Wiz smart bulb as night lamp (10% brightness). AC via 40A SSR + NodeMCU flashed with Tasmota inside the AC stabilizer. Auto-shutoff at 5 AM, stabilizer powers down 5 min later. DIY SSR using LED + LDR for optoisolation.

items.title: Living Room
items.textHtml: Echo Dot 3rd Gen for voice control. 4-channel relay + ESP8266 manages TV, bias lighting, and 5.1 soundbar via Sinric Pro. Custom Alexa routines: "Movie Time" dims lights & enables soundbar; "Movie Break" pauses media and restores lights to 50%.

items.title: Kitchen
items.textHtml: Water pump timer using 40A SSR + Arduino Nano. 3-button interface: 2-min, 7-min, and reset. Prevents tank overflow and saves energy. Housed in a standard 2-module electrical box.

items.descHtml: TV on → soundbar connects via HDMI ARC → LED strip on → main light off
Media paused via IR → Wiz bulb at 50% brightness
AC steps down 24°C → 26°C → off; fan off at 6 AM

items.alt: IoT smart home setup with relay modules

items.title: Smart home living room automation demo

blocks.html: Upgraded a standard GoldMedal 6-socket extension box with a 6-channel relay (4+2), ESP32, and AC-to-DC 5V 2A adapter. Individual socket control via IR remote, ESP RainMaker app, Alexa, or Google Assistant. Added a reset switch and external USB-A port for OTA reprogramming.

items: IR remote assigns unique commands per socket; '0' kills all sockets
Timer and automation support via ESP RainMaker

projects.title: Bike Keyless Entry via IoT
projects.subtitleHtml: Wi-Fi & RF-based proximity keyless system for a motorcycle

blocks.html: A 4-channel relay + NodeMCU ESP8266 connected to the bike's ignition, kill switch, and self-start — controllable via Alexa, Google Assistant, or a WearOS app. Powered by 12V-to-USB adapter from the bike battery. Salvaged RF module from an RC car converted into a keychain remote for proximity auto-lock/unlock (locks beyond ~10m).

items: Ignition, kill switch, and self-start via app/voice
Proximity auto-lock/unlock via salvaged RF module

projects.title: IoT RC Car with Custom Web Controller
projects.subtitleHtml: Wi-Fi controlled car built from salvaged RC parts, controlled via a local HTTP page

blocks.html: Built a Wi-Fi RC car using a NodeMCU ESP8266 and motor controller, salvaging the gearbox, motors, and wheels from an old RC chassis. Control handled through a locally hosted HTTP page served by the ESP8266 — no app install needed.

items.title: IoT RC car web controller demo

projects.title: DIY Smart Home Display (Echo Show Clone)
projects.subtitleHtml: Repurposed damaged POCO M3 as a portable smart home hub

blocks.html: A POCO M3 with a broken charging port, dead SIM, and broken GPS was repaired (display replaced), debloated (85–90% MIUI removed), and mounted in a custom holder with an integrated 5W speaker and 10,000 mAh power bank. Runs Alexa as a full voice assistant for smart home control and media playback.

categories.title: Server Virtualization, Cloud & Network Engineering
categories.descriptionHtml: Homelab and production-grade network deployments using open-source tools — from multi-OS Proxmox environments to enterprise-style network design for a 35-room villa compound.

projects.title: AIO Home Server — Multi-OS Virtualization Platform
projects.subtitleHtml: Repurposed HP i3 laptop running Proxmox VE + Raspberry Pi 5 node

blocks.html: Transformed an idle HP i3 laptop by upgrading SSD/RAM and modifying the power button for lid-closed booting. Installed Proxmox VE for full virtualization, running multiple OS instances with automated backups and snapshots. A Raspberry Pi 5 runs UmbrelOS/CasaOS with a 500 GB SSD for private cloud storage.

items.title: Virtualization & VMs
items.textHtml: Proxmox VE hosting Ubuntu Server, Kali Linux, Windows 11, Windows Server, Android TV OS, and multiple LXC containers. Accessible via VNC from any browser.

items.title: Remote Access
items.textHtml: Cloudflare Tunnel for HTTPS public access via custom subdomains. Tailscale VPN (WireGuard) for secure mesh networking across all devices.

items.title: Private Cloud Storage
items.textHtml: Nextcloud + OpenMediaVault on Raspberry Pi 5 with 500 GB SSD. Accessible across Windows (SMB), Linux, and Android.

items.title: Media & Web Services
items.textHtml: Plex + Jellyfin for media streaming. Internal web server for personal projects. Firefox proxy browser inside CasaOS.

items.title: IoT Integration
items.textHtml: Tasmota-managed IoT devices on LAN, remotely accessible via Tailscale + Cloudflare Tunnel.

items.title: VoIP System
items.textHtml: Asterisk + FreePBX configured for a local IVR and telephony setup.

projects.title: Villa Network — Multi-Compound Wi-Fi Deployment & NOC Dashboard
projects.subtitleHtml: 35-room, 160+ concurrent user network across two compounds · Freelance · Dec 2024

blocks.html: Designed and deployed a cost-effective enterprise-grade Wi-Fi network across two villa compounds with 35 rooms, supporting 110+ Wi-Fi users and 160+ peak concurrent users. All 16 routers repurposed from existing hardware, configured as APs with static IPs and non-overlapping channels. Achieved 200–230 Mb/s stable throughput.

rows: Primary router — traffic management & inter-compound link via CAT6
Distribution switch linked to main Etisalat ISP router
Access Points — DHCP disabled, static IPs, staggered channels
24/7 monitoring via Zabbix, Nagios, Ntopng — zero additional cost

blocks.html: Custom homelab-style Network Operations Center web dashboard using Vanilla JS, hosted via Blogger layout override. Provides unified LAN/WAN health visibility with embedded monitoring tools, real-time clock, and a dark-mode admin UI.

items.title: WAN Monitoring
items.textHtml: Embedded Fast.com speed test, public uptime tracking, external network status monitoring.

items.title: Planned Enhancements
items.textHtml: Prometheus + Grafana, Docker backend, SNMP, authentication layer, PWA deployment, AWS/Azure hosting.

items.title: Pi-hole DNS & Filtering
items.textHtml: Self-hosted Pi-hole for network-wide ad blocking, DNS filtering, and traffic monitoring — acts as a lightweight firewall layer across all 160+ users.

projects.title: Homelab Server Monitor — Proxmox, LXC & Docker Dashboard
projects.subtitleHtml: Custom framebuffer dashboard for Raspberry Pi 5 with MHS 3.5" touchscreen

blocks.html: A custom-built display dashboard for a Raspberry Pi 5 with an MHS 3.5" touchscreen, rendering directly to the framebuffer (/dev/fb0). Provides real-time monitoring of Proxmox VE backups, remote Linux/Windows devices, and network health, fully configurable from a browser-based web UI.

items.title: Multi-Screen Monitoring
items.textHtml: Clock/weather, system stats, network info, remote device CPU/RAM/disk mini-bars, ping latency sparklines, aggregated alerts, Uptime Kuma monitor list, firewall (pfSense/OPNsense) status, Pi-hole stats, habit tracker, countdowns, and a local photo slideshow.

items.title: Proxmox & Remote Agents
items.textHtml: Pulls Proxmox VE backup task history via the REST API and surfaces failures as alerts; lightweight Linux and Windows agent scripts report device stats to the dashboard over a simple JSON API.

items.title: Web Configuration UI
items.textHtml: A local web server for configuring theme, fonts, alignment, screen order/visibility, alert thresholds, and integrations entirely from a browser — no code editing required, with login-protected access.

items.title: Extras
items.textHtml: ARP watch and port-scan reminders for lightweight LAN security monitoring, a server-side notification inbox for companion apps, and save/load config snapshot profiles.

philosophy.heading: What Drives Me
paragraphsHtml: I believe the best solutions combine security, efficiency, and user experience. Whether I'm hardening a school network against threats, automating a home to save energy, or repurposing old hardware into something useful, my goal is always the same: make technology work smarter, not harder.

My journey from curious hobbyist to certified ethical hacker and IT administrator proves that passion and persistence can rival any formal degree. I'm constantly learning, building, and sharing — because technology is too exciting to keep to yourself.
